title: Sparse Competition during Training For the Emergence of Specialized Modules
abstract: arXiv:2608.30978v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modularity in deep neural networks has been proposed as a means of improving both interpretability and training by promoting disentangled representations and reducing redundancy. In this work, we study the emergence of modular structure through competition dynamics between groups of neurons during training. We introduce a method that (i) maintains near-baseline accuracy, (ii) induces usage-based modularity by sparsely routing inputs to neuron groups, and (iii) encourages specialization of these modules, such that their activations are correlated with input classes. We evaluate the proposed approach on ImageNet-100 and CIFAR-100 and show that with it, specialized modules emerge without module-level supervision. These modules capture a meaningful high-level structure in the data, with individual modules responding to semantic categories (e.g., dogs or vehicles). We also study the emergence of a hierarchical partition of sub-tasks depending

translated_title: 训练过程中的稀疏竞争以促进专用模块的涌现
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络中的模块化被认为是一种提升可解释性和训练效果的手段，其方式是促进解耦表示并减少冗余。在这项工作中，我们研究了训练过程中神经元组之间的竞争动态如何催生模块化结构。我们提出了一种方法：(i) 保持接近基线的准确率；(ii) 通过将输入稀疏地路由到神经元组来诱导基于使用模式的模块化；(iii) 促使这些模块实现专门化，使其激活与输入类别相关联。我们在ImageNet-100和CIFAR-100上评估了所提出的方法，结果表明该方法无需模块级别的监督即可使专用模块自然涌现。这些模块捕捉了数据中有意义的高层结构，各个模块会对语义类别（例如狗或车辆）做出响应。我们还研究了子任务层次化划分的涌现，其依赖于……
tldr: 该论文提出通过训练期间神经元组之间的稀疏竞争机制，在无需模块级监督的情况下，使深度神经网络自发涌现出与语义类别对应的专用模块，同时保持接近基线的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a sparse competition mechanism among neuron groups during training, enabling deep neural networks to spontaneously emerge specialized modules that respond to semantic categories without module-level supervision, while maintaining near-baseline accuracy.
